class.name: UserSettings
class.brief_description: Handles user settings in a centralized way.
class.description: Stores user settings in the [code]user://settings.cfg[/code] file and exposes a small API for reading and writing values grouped by section and key. Missing keys are filled with built-in defaults during [method load_config], so callers can safely read settings even when the config file does not exist yet or does not contain every supported option. The class also provides a dedicated helper for the configured Maszyna game directory. Separately, [method get_current_graphics_backend] and [method save_graphics_backend] manage which graphics backend (rendering driver) the engine uses. This is not stored in [code]settings.cfg[/code]: the backend must be known before the engine boots and any script runs, so it is instead written to an [code]override.cfg[/code] file that Godot reads at startup, and only takes effect after a restart.

method.name: get_current_graphics_backend
method.description: Returns the name of the graphics backend the engine is currently running with: [code]"vulkan"[/code], [code]"opengl3"[/code], [code]"d3d12"[/code] or [code]"metal"[/code]. This is detected live from the running [RenderingServer], not read from saved settings, so it always reflects the backend actually in use for the current session (which may differ from a backend saved via [method save_graphics_backend] until the game is restarted).

method.name: get_maszyna_game_dir
method.description: Returns the configured Maszyna game directory. In release builds outside the editor this method always returns [code]"."[/code]. If the stored value is empty, [code]"."[/code] is returned as a fallback.

method.name: get_setting
method.description: Returns a setting value from the given config [param section] and [param key]. If the key does not exist, [param default_value] is returned.

method.name: load_config
method.description: Loads the config file from [code]user://settings.cfg[/code]. If the file does not exist yet, a new one is created with default values. After loading, any missing supported keys are added automatically.

method.name: save_graphics_backend
method.description: Requests that the game use the given graphics backend on its next launch. [param backend] must be one of [code]"vulkan"[/code], [code]"opengl3"[/code], [code]"d3d12"[/code] or [code]"metal"[/code]. The rendering driver is selected by the engine before any script runs, so this cannot change it for the current session. Instead, it writes an [code]override.cfg[/code] file next to the running project (or executable, in an exported build), which Godot reads at startup before initializing the renderer. The change only takes effect after the game is restarted. On success, [signal graphics_backend_changed] is emitted.

method.name: save_maszyna_game_dir
method.description: Saves the Maszyna game directory path to the config file. This is a shortcut for writing the [code]maszyna/game_dir[/code] setting.

method.name: save_setting
method.description: Saves [param value] under the given config [param section] and [param key]. If the stored value changes, [signal setting_changed] and [signal config_changed] are emitted.

signal.name: config_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the config was loaded or after a setting value was changed and saved.

signal.name: graphics_backend_changed
signal.description: Emitted after [method save_graphics_backend] successfully writes the requested backend to [code]override.cfg[/code]. The engine must still be restarted for the new backend to actually take effect.

signal.name: setting_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a saved setting changes value.
